location.fact: Campaign start (3rd of Second Seed, 3E 432): Cassius Aurelinus, newly knighted into the Dragonguard, reports for garrison duty at Bruma under Tribune Sabina Ostorius. Regional backdrop: Bruma Pass closed early last year, stranding a merchant queue that became its own furious temporary town; the Count of Bruma and the pass garrison have been blaming each other in writing, and the Elder Council now holds the letters. This campaign runs parallel to and unconnected from Hakon Stonebreaker's (Twilight of the Third Era), sharing only the world/ruleset, not plot or location.
